methodology.optimizer: Initial 13-weight CEM (8x12) then static-evaluation-only CEM (6x8) with greedy opponent and control
methodology.robust: 5 static weights; ordering fixed to original; original4/incumbent4/greedy opponents, 36 training games each per candidate. Validation 120 games each vs 3 opponents plus original-vs-greedy control. Promotion >53% vs incumbent, >52% vs original, greedy >= control-1pp, no capped games.
methodology.confidence: normal approximation of independent colour-swapped pair means, stratified by board; draws count half
methodology.heldoutUse: Coefficients frozen before final seeds. Board adoption follows the predeclared Bonferroni primary tests and matched-greedy guard; aggregate candidate rates describe the global candidate, not the routed deployed policy.

rule.primary: paired mean score >0.5 with one-sided z=2.394 (Bonferroni alpha=.05/6)
rule.secondary: vs greedy, candidate observed score >= original observed score on matched seeds; report paired difference CI without formal non-inferiority claim
rule.otherwise: retain original 4-ply parameters on that board
rule.note: Pre-specified board-wise tests; report all boards, including rejected ones. Candidate aggregate rate is not the rate of a routed deployed policy.

baseline.method: 4-ply WASM; includes input validation/copy and history replay; excludes Worker messaging/rendering; 2 warmup rounds, 5 measured rounds over 50 positions per board

tuned.method: 4-ply WASM; includes input validation/copy and history replay; excludes Worker messaging/rendering; 2 warmup rounds, 5 measured rounds over 50 positions per board
